name: DIOSMECTITE 3G 10 SACHETS IPRIKENE
description: Diosmectite 3g in sachets, usually marketed under brand names like IprikenE, is an antidiarrheal medication. Its main function is the symptomatic treatment of acute and chronic diarrhea in adults and children. Antidiarrheal medication used to treat diarrhea in children and adults. It requires a prescription.
